The Library’s website is our gateway to our resources and services. It provides a brief introduction to the facilities and services provided by the library, library operating hours and other basic information pertaining to the library. The primary objective of the library is to implement, enrich, and support the educational programmes of GCTU. Newsflash Announcements We enjoy sharing the latest happenings within our community.
